title: airnow 0.2.0
text: AirNow retires web services behind get_airnow_conditions() get_airnow_forecast() 2026-09-30. release moves package replacement services released June 2026.

title: airnow 0.2.0
text: get_airnow_observations() returns current readings ZIP code, coordinates, reporting area code, derived utc_datetime column. get_airnow_forecasts() returns forecasts currently issued location. get_airnow_forecast_history() returns past forecasts reporting area date range. replaces get_airnow_forecast(date = ). get_airnow_reporting_area() finds reporting area serves location. ZIP codes whose area forecast issued today fall back AirNow’s bundled ZIP crosswalk. get_airnow_monitors() new name get_airnow_area(). get_airnow_key() set_airnow_key() replace token-named credential helpers.

title: airnow 0.2.0
text: airnow_areas lists every AirNow reporting area code, location, time zone, agency.

title: airnow 0.2.0
text: get_airnow_conditions(), get_airnow_forecast(), get_airnow_area(), get_airnow_token(), set_airnow_token() still work warn. first two call new services reshape result old columns. Row counts AQI values can differ retired services AirNow changed lookup methodology; LocalTimeZone now correct wrong ; distance ignored; get_airnow_forecast(date = ) returns forecasts valid date . Dated calls ZIPs AirNow’s bundled crosswalk longer depend forecast issued today. additive area argument provides exact fallback coordinates ZIPs absent crosswalk preserving legacy output columns.

title: airnow 0.2.0
text: Requests use HTTPS. Previously API key made first hop plain HTTP redirect. API error messages reported instead malformed data frame. Requests match data return zero-row tibble. aqi_color() aqi_descriptor() accept values 500 (treated Hazardous) NA, warn instead erroring negative values. Real AirNow data exceeds 500 smoke events. Unrecognized pollutant category names now warn instead silently becoming NA. Derived UTC observation times account half- quarter-hour time zones. get_airnow_forecast_history() warns asked dates future. AirNow serves forecasts today, requests return rows; get_airnow_forecasts() upcoming forecasts.
